author: Trong Chien
reason: Measure untouched starter behavior before prompt/tool changes
hypothesis: The intentionally incomplete starter prompt/tool descriptions will expose routing, missing-information, confirmation, and multi-turn failures.

author: Trong Chien
reason: Add explicit routing, missing-information handling, no-tool scope rules, and ticket confirmation boundary.
hypothesis: If the system prompt explicitly distinguishes shared service/device/KB/user/report routes and requires clarification/confirmation, wrong-tool, missing-info, unnecessary-tool, and write-boundary failures should decrease.

author: Trong Chien
reason: Strengthen tool descriptions and argument conventions, including one-call-per-asset/environment and confirmation semantics.
hypothesis: If tool descriptions encode when to use each tool and how to preserve arguments, routing and argument accuracy should improve without hard-coding evaluation cases.

author: Trong Chien
reason: Add latest-intent precedence, correction/cancellation semantics, confirmation invalidation, privacy, and parallel tool-call guidance.
hypothesis: If the prompt makes latest intent authoritative and permits only the independent tool calls required by that intent, multi-turn and parallel-call accuracy should improve while stale/extra calls decrease.
